title: Ukraine peace talks are back on
credits: Photos: Azimbek Assarov, Glib Albovsky, David Rodrigo, Robert Anasch / Unsplash · Map: Natural Earth
lines: After months of silence, Russia and Ukraine could be back at the negotiating table next month.
On Wednesday, the American envoy Steve Witkoff met Vladimir Putin in Saint Petersburg, for about three hours.
It was his ninth face-to-face meeting with the Russian president.
Russia opened with a goodwill gesture, releasing Stephen Hubbard, a retired American teacher it had been holding.
A day earlier, Witkoff was in Oslo, meeting Volodymyr Zelensky along with European leaders.
Now, the Kremlin says Putin has agreed to resume American-mediated talks with Ukraine.
Putin's aide, Yuri Ushakov, says a new three-way round could be held around the middle of November.
Abu Dhabi, in the United Arab Emirates, is being discussed as a possible venue.
Zelensky told Fox News that freezing the front line is the first step, saying: this is the real way to end this war.
The last American-mediated talks were held in February, before the war with Iran began.
No terms of any peace deal have been agreed yet, and the fighting goes on.
